The '''Pirr-Ol Underpassage''' was a subterranean complex built beneath the [[Old Paths]] region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. During the [[Galactic War]], it was a haven of the [[Exchange]] and served as a hideout of [[Rogun Matt'rik|Rogun the Butcher's]] right hand, [[Jela Reneke]].<ref name="TOR" /> [[Pol Blex]] and his crew had a presence here, selling weaponry and technology.

==Behind the scenes==
The Pirr-Ol Underpassage appears as a location in the Old Paths on Voss in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
